prs.title: Sm 565/guided experience UI
prs.author: Mauro
prs.rationale: A substantial new guided-experience UI surface with 16 custom component/page files, multiple new components (Tray, TaskCard, InlinePrompt, SkipReasonPrompt, SuggestedQuestions, TaskSteps, TaskDates, CrmConnectPanel), custom hooks, and AppShell integration representing a major feature with architectural scope.

prs.title: Move competitor marketplace enrichment off the Save path (SM-549)
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Moves competitor marketplace enrichment off the synchronous save path into a background BullMQ job, touching the worker pipeline, new job type, status polling hook, and multiple layout components to surface async collection status — a significant architectural shift across the full stack.

prs.title: Fix worker "Cannot find module './registry'" on cache-miss field lookups
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Small targeted fix to resolve a module resolution issue on cache-miss field lookups across only two files with 33 custom lines.

prs.title: ACE AWS Products: SM-541
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: Adds AWS product data handling for ACE enrichment across four files, with hardening against prototype keys and a fix for product lookups, representing a solid feature addition with contributions from two authors.

prs.title: SM-642: Resolve proper company name from domain
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Implements a new company name resolution service with dedicated library module, integrates it into the readiness orchestrator and registry, surfaces it in two admin pages, updates rival promotion, and includes unit tests — a significant cross-cutting feature.

prs.title: fix(readiness): recover from marketplace listing dedup races on update/discovery paths
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Addresses race conditions in marketplace listing deduplication across both update and discovery paths, with Dockerfile changes, two substantial test files, and logic changes in two core modules — meaningful reliability hardening with good test coverage.

prs.title: feat: add product from AWS Marketplace URL + edit company name
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Adds two distinct user-facing features (add product from AWS Marketplace URL and edit company name) spanning new UI components, server actions, a new AWS Marketplace listing-details library, and an e2e test — a solid medium-large feature delivery.

prs.title: fix(studio): Bedrock toolConfig on competitive-analysis finalize (prod hotfix)
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Targeted hotfix correcting Bedrock toolConfig on the competitive-analysis finalize step with an accompanying unit test, modest in scope but non-trivial in AI agent context.

prs.title: fix(readiness): scope Product.marketplaceListingId unique per company (prod hotfix)
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Scopes a unique constraint on Product.marketplaceListingId per company via a Prisma schema change and migration, with an updated dedup test — a focused data-model fix.

prs.title: fix(automation): enforce tenant isolation on automation actions
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Enforces tenant isolation across automation actions and the assistant agent, touching the control layer, tool index, two action files, and adding a unit test — a meaningful security/correctness fix with moderate cross-cutting scope.

prs.title: fix(studio): enqueue BTS generation directly from assessment + strategy slides
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Small two-file fix that directly enqueues BTS generation from assessment and strategy slide components rather than going through an indirect path — a minor targeted fix.

prs.title: Revert #475 (guided-experience UI / action-needed tray) out of staging
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: A revert of PR #475 with 386 lines of additions (restoring prior state across 17 files); the cognitive effort is low as it is undoing known work rather than producing novel logic.

prs.title: Terraform IaC foundation for AWS Cognito migration
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Establishes a full Terraform IaC foundation for AWS Cognito migration across 44 files including bootstrap, environment configs, CI/CD workflow integration, and comprehensive documentation — a major infrastructure architectural undertaking.

prs.title: Studio: move BTS & Competitive Analysis generation to background workers
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Moves BTS and Competitive Analysis generation to background workers with new BullMQ job types, Prisma schema additions, updated AI agent graphs, studio UI polling/status components, and API routes — a major architectural feature spanning the full stack.

prs.title: fix(docker): ship docs/ into runner image so admin docs load
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Trivial single-file Dockerfile change to copy the docs directory into the runner image.

prs.title: fix(docker): ship docs/ into runner image so admin docs load
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Trivial single-file Dockerfile change adding a COPY instruction to include docs directory in the runner image.

prs.title: Playbook editing + AI assistant guided flow
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Transformative epic spanning 35+ files including new AI assistant guided flow, playbook editing UI, automation agent tools, schema migrations, server actions, and extensive documentation — clearly weeks of work touching Core Platform, AI/Agents, and UI/UX simultaneously.

stories.name: Guided Experience & Action-Needed Tray
stories.rationale: Introduced and then reverted the guided experience UI and action-needed tray, representing an in-progress initiative to improve user onboarding flow.

stories.name: AWS Marketplace Integration & Product Management
stories.rationale: Delivered end-to-end AWS Marketplace integration including ACE product sync, adding products via URL, deduplication race condition fixes, scoping unique listing IDs per company, and moving enrichment off the critical save path.

stories.name: Company Domain Intelligence & Name Resolution
stories.rationale: Improved data quality by enabling the platform to accurately resolve a company's proper name from its domain.

stories.name: AI Studio Background Processing & Reliability
stories.rationale: Moved BTS and Competitive Analysis generation to background workers for scalability, fixed direct enqueuing from assessment slides, patched a Bedrock toolConfig production hotfix, and resolved a module registry cache-miss worker crash.

stories.name: Playbook Editing with AI Assistant
stories.rationale: Launched a major new capability allowing users to edit playbooks with the assistance of an AI-guided flow.

stories.name: Tenant Isolation & Security Hardening
stories.rationale: Enforced strict tenant isolation on automation actions to prevent cross-tenant data leakage.

stories.name: AWS Cognito Authentication Migration Foundation
stories.rationale: Established the Terraform infrastructure-as-code foundation required to migrate authentication to AWS Cognito.

stories.name: Admin Documentation Availability Fix
stories.rationale: Fixed Docker runner images to include the docs directory so that admin documentation loads correctly in all environments.
